## Native wallpaper submission

Target the active dev branch of KyaKayKya/Spatial-Wallpaper-Community.
Add exactly one submission metadata file; do not include a package, source changes or caches.
Initial submissions also register their source repository. A registry-only PR
registers discovery and does not approve any work or future revision.
See [creator instructions](../../docs/guides/壁纸市场创作者入门.md).

- Author repository and numeric repository ID:
- Stable wallpaper GUID (unchanged across revisions):
- Exact revision and stable GitHub Release tag:
- Exact single .spatial asset name:
- packageSha256 (copy the exact `sha256` from the trusted NativeValidator report):
- SDK 0.4.0-preview.1 / schema5 / scene-command ABI1:
- Original authors and licenses for every asset, script and sound:
- Link to redistribution evidence:
- Existing official Issue for this wallpaper (if any):

I confirm that my author repository default-branch wallpaper.json grants listing
consent, that the package uses verified redistribution records, and that this
revision does not overwrite an existing version or change the stable GUID.
The submission file binds this work GUID, revision and package SHA256; changing
wallpaper.json or uploading a new Release does not approve a later revision.
The automatic metadata/native validator checks do not certify copyright,
GPU driver safety, script correctness, or visual/audio quality.
